basics.name: Priyanka Chatterjee
basics.label: Full-Stack Software Engineer · Data Pipelines & Insights APIs · Python · TypeScript · AWS · 4+ Years

summaries.default: Full-stack software engineer with 4+ years building scalable data pipelines, insights APIs, and distributed systems in Python, TypeScript, and Go across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Demonstrated expertise in operational excellence—monitoring, incident management, performance optimization—and shipping full-lifecycle features from design through deployment. Engineered Kafka-based data pipelines processing 1,000+ events per second with dead-letter queues; optimized PostgreSQL queries powering compliance data analysis by 40% (cut processing time from 3 minutes to 1.5 minutes across 10,000+ records); led microservice migrations cutting resource-discovery latency 70–90% via event-driven architecture.

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
highlights: Engineered a Kafka-based, fire-and-forget event-driven data pipeline for policy-enforcement workflows with asynchronous consumer processing and a dead-letter queue (DLQ) for fault tolerance; ensured reliability and observability in high-volume data processing.

Built core features for Tailpipe, a Go-based observability and data CLI on DuckDB + Parquet, lifting data-processing throughput 30% to 1,000+ records per second by optimizing chunking, batching, and streaming writes; reduced memory use to eliminate out-of-memory failures.

Authored 11 AWS log-source data tables for Tailpipe in Go (CloudTrail, GuardDuty, SecurityHub, ALB/NLB/CLB/ELB access logs, S3 access, VPC flow, WAF, Network Firewall) with 25+ pre-built analytics/security detections; designed cross-platform smoke-test pipeline.

Optimized complex PostgreSQL queries powering enterprise data analysis and compliance audits — rewriting IAM policy-evaluation queries with jsonb array operations, multi-stage CTEs, and conditional filtering — improving query performance 40% (cutting report-generation from 3 minutes to 1.5 minutes across 10,000+ records) and eliminating false-positive findings.

Designed and developed a REST API microservice in Go using Gin framework with OAuth 2.0 authentication, containerized with Docker, deployed to AWS EC2, and integrated as a gRPC client for internal microservices; handled production traffic with high reliability.

Led the AWS SDK for JavaScript v2 to v3 migration across 180+ call sites and 11+ AWS services (Lambda, CloudWatch, SecurityHub, X-Ray, EC2, and others) in production Node.js Lambda functions, reducing bundle size through modular imports and keeping the platform supported past EOL.

Designed multi-distro Linux smoke tests (CentOS, Ubuntu ARM64, macOS) for data CLI tools in GitHub Actions release pipelines, hardening deployment safety and catching regressions; unified release workflows and automated Slack notifications for four open-source products.

Conducted root cause analysis on production incidents — diagnosed a Go service stuck in Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff by investigating pod logs and service status with the platform team — and implemented preventive measures to avoid recurrence.
